Author: Iluay
Name: Magia Wheel Plus
Punchline: Magia board bar with spin buttons and auto toggles, plus auto Next for lockbox / appraisal results.
Description: A small native four-button bar next to the Eureka magia board: one-shot Attack and Defense spins (/magiaattack, /magiadefense), Auto Attack and Auto Defense toggles (/magiaauto), and an arrow to swap the bar to the other side of the board. Also adds an "Auto next" checkbox above the lockbox / logogram appraisal window that presses Next on the results for you.
